about: West Nipissing is a municipality in northeastern Ontario on Lake Nipissing, centred on Sturgeon Falls with surrounding Francophone and bilingual communities. Forestry heritage, a riverside downtown, and cottage-country access toward the French River define the amalgamated municipality. Highways 17 and 64 meet near Sturgeon Falls. About 14,000 people live in West Nipissing.
